answers.core: This is as basic as it gets. I'm surprised that it doesn't exist yet.
answers.workaround: Oh, man, I'm sure there is a very good reason for filtering being the default, as it is also a problem in Gamemaker, but cmon. People use these types of engines for pixel games. And it's not a loud minority. If there is overwhelming proof that the vast majority (and not 50:50) like blurry and ugly assets in their games, then I wanna see that statistic.

title: Add a toggle for globally disabling "filter" so people don't have to re-import their assets constantly
